scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/sync && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/account
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @ftcref/sync exec wrangler d1 migrations apply ftcref --local --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm --filter @ftcref/sync exec wrangler d1 migrations apply ftcref --remote
scripts.db:migrate:stage: pnpm --filter @ftcref/sync exec wrangler d1 migrations apply ftcref-stage --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:auth:local: pnpm --filter @ftcref/account exec wrangler d1 migrations apply ftcref-auth --local --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:auth:remote: pnpm --filter @ftcref/account exec wrangler d1 migrations apply ftcref-auth --remote
scripts.db:migrate:auth:stage: pnpm --filter @ftcref/account exec wrangler d1 migrations apply ftcref-stage-auth --remote --env staging
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter @ftcref/sync deploy && pnpm --filter @ftcref/account deploy && pnpm --filter @ftcref/web deploy
scripts.deploy:stage: pnpm --filter @ftcref/sync deploy:stage && pnpm --filter @ftcref/account deploy:stage && pnpm --filter @ftcref/web deploy:stage
